1) Attachments: we received the ACH form and voided check. Please sign the DocuSign we just sent so finance has an executed enrollment on file: https://docusign.net/ENVELOPEID/abc123.

2) Remittance mapping: Redwood prefers a stable PO tag to match invoices to POs. We typically ingest a CSV with a header row that maps to our internal fields. Can you confirm if you can include a stable "po_number" column and a separate "remit_code" column for special cases? If you can support that we can automate PO matching.

3) Delivery options: SFTP or manual upload to our vendor portal are both fine — portal link is here: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/clearharbor. If SFTP, we will send connection details after the DocuSign is complete.

4) Timing: finance will kick off micro-deposit verification once the signed enrollment is on file. Expect two small micro-deposits from our bank within 1–2 business days. After you confirm the amounts, we'll flip the account to live for ACH.

Attached is our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf to show required fields and sample header mapping. Please review and send back the signed DocuSign envelope.

Next steps for you: sign DocuSign, confirm CSV header mapping (po_number + remit_code included), and reply with expected first payment date.

Best,
